09/14.03.2024:
I.A.No. 11648/23; I.A.No. 8162/22 & I.A.No.5293/22 The instant Interlocutory
Applications have been filed by the appellants praying therein to suspend the
sentence and release them on bail during the pendency of this appeal.

2.  The appellants have been convicted and sentenced in connection with Special POCSO Case No. 36 Bittu Behra @ Rakesh vs The State Of Jharkhand on 14 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/128212341/
1 of 2019, arising out of Toklo P.S. Case No. 10 of 2019, for offences under Sections 363/34, 376(2) (n)
of I.P.C. and Section 6 of POCSO Act; under Section 354A of the I.P.C. and Section 8 of the POCSO Act.

entities.text: Special POCSO Case No. 36 Bittu Behra @ Rakesh vs The State Of Jharkhand
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
They have been sentenced to undergo rigorous imprisonment for 12 years under Section 376 (2)
(n) of I.P.C. amongst other sentences.

3. Heard the learned Counsel for the appellants and the learned A.P.P. for the State and have gone through the impugned judgment, the evidence and the Trial Court Records.
4.
Opportunity was given to the State to oppose the bail, which the State availed and opposed.
5. Having heard the submissions of the learned Counsel for the parties and after going through the records, we find that the victim has been examined as P.W.1 and she supported the prosecution case.

The case of the co-convict has also been rejected by the Co-ordinate Bench of this Court in Cr.
Appeal (D.B.) No. 557 of 2022 on 16.01.2023 wherein the Co-ordinate Bench has found that the medical report indicated that repeated sexual intercourse has been done on the victim.
6. Considering the aforesaid fact, we are not inclined to grant bail to the appellants.
Hence their prayer for bail is rejected.
7. Accordingly, I.A.No. 11648 of 2023; I.A.No. 8162 of 2022 & I.A.No.5293 of 2022 are dismissed.

(Ananda Sen, J.) (Subhash Chand, J.) P.K.S.
